# Exercise 3.2
1. I prepare for analysis by inspecting the data first. What can you expect when opening the file. What are the name of the columns and rows. Do you have the right file etc.
2. You need the excel worksheet All cycles for the analysis. That sheet contains the raw data of measurements of each sample in each wells collected over time.
3. Load the library tidyverse and readxl and open the All cycle sheet with read_excel function and assign it to an R object
4. Need to remove the row time under each column and adjust the names of each raw data column to specify the time
5. Salmonella wells over time
6. Dear researcher,
You have done well however several changes can be made. First I would change the file name from salmonella CFU kinetics OD600 in LB van ipecs 8okt2020 kleur to salmonella cfu measured over time. I would also remove the time row and change each column to represent the time so that this data can be analysed

# Exercise 3.3
```{r exercise3.3}
myDir <- here::here(
  "data",
  "md5_examples"
)
fileNames <- list.files(myDir, recursive = TRUE)
tools::md5sum(file.path(myDir, fileNames)) %>% enframe() -> md5sums_all
md5sums_all$filename <- fileNames
md5sums_all %>% select(filename,value)
```
